title: Web dependencies missing in a fresh capsule
why: The web repo has no capsule setup, so a new capsule has no node_modules.

seen.said: `pnpm test` failed with `vitest: command not found` until `pnpm install`.
A fresh capsule has no node_modules: `tsc` isn't found.
Ran `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` before the type-check could run.

title: PDF snapshot tests need wkhtmltopdf
change: Install wkhtmltopdf on this machine (`brew install wkhtmltopdf`): without it the PDF snapshot tests fail in every capsule.
why: `just test` runs the PDF snapshot tests, which call wkhtmltopdf.

seen.said: `just test` fails on the PDF snapshots: wkhtmltopdf isn't installed. `go test ./internal/...` runs the rest.
PDF snapshot tests fail: no wkhtmltopdf.

title: Date tests fail outside UTC
change: Set `TZ=UTC` in the justfile's `test` recipe, or have `TestDueDates` set the zone itself.

seen.said: Due dates come out a day early unless TZ=UTC.

title: Seed data needs the local database up
change: Say in AGENTS.md that `just db-up` comes before `just seed`.
why: `just seed` waits for Postgres without saying so.

seen.said: `just seed` hung until `just db-up` had started Postgres.
`pnpm lint` fails on `src/generated/api.ts`, which is made by `just codegen`.
Lint errors in generated files; ignored them.
